description: This nested pie chart, or sunburst chart, illustrates the distribution of various character types across broad categories and specific subcategories. The chart consists of an inner ring with three main categories and an outer ring with thirteen corresponding subcategories, totaling sixteen distinct segments. The inner ring is dominated by "Virtual Characters" in blue, which accounts for approximately three-quarters of the total area, followed by "Real Characters" in green at roughly fifteen percent, and "Custom Characters" in pink at roughly ten percent. The outer ring further divides these main sections into lighter-colored slices. The blue "Virtual Characters" section is split into five outer slices: an unlabeled top slice partially obscured by a grey rectangle, "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters." The pink "Custom Characters" section corresponds to a single unlabeled outer slice. The green "Real Characters" section is divided into seven outer slices labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," which appear visually ordered in descending size clockwise. The chart does not include a separate legend or numerical percentage labels; instead, text labels are placed directly on or adjacent to their respective slices and are color-coded to match the segments they describe.
